definitions.explanation: A condominium building of roughly 20 stories or more. Common in urban Japan since the 2000s. Often shortened to タワマン in casual speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都心|としん}→都心：04072_toshin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧タワーマンション⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいる→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
examples.english: I live in a high-rise condo in the city center.

examples.japanese: タワーマンション⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{最上階|さいじょうかい}→最上階：30428_saijoukai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だ。
examples.english: The view from the top floor of the tower apartment is amazing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{湾岸|わんがん}→湾岸：13396_wangan⟧⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧タワーマンション⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{建|た}てられている→建てる：01189_tateru⟧。
examples.english: New high-rise condos are being built one after another in the bayside district.

notes:
Wasei-eigo from English "tower" + "mansion." In Japan, ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧ refers to a condominium building, not a luxury house — see ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧. There is no firm legal definition, but 20 stories or more is the usual threshold.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- タワーマンション⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}む→住む：00673_sumu⟧: to live in a high-rise condo
- タワーマンション⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{購入|こうにゅう}→購入：03057_kounyuu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to purchase a high-rise condo
- ⟦{高層|こうそう}→高層：04145_kousou⟧タワーマンション: high-rise tower apartment
- タワマン: casual abbreviation

CULTURAL NOTE:
Owning a high floor in a タワーマンション has become a status symbol in Tokyo and Osaka. The term タワマン{民|みん} ("tower-mansion people") is sometimes used in pop culture to refer to their lifestyle.
